To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the phonon anomalies observed in the non-multiferrocic compounds are mainly due to the orbital-spin-phononic coupling while in the multiferrocic compounds, the phonon anomalies are mainly due to local oxygen rearrangement.

the frequency softenings of PrMn O 3 and NdM nO 3 are partly attributed to the orbital-spin-phononic coupling whereas the relatively weak frequency softenings of TbMn O 2 3 and DyM n O 3 are rather attributed to the expansion of the Mn − O bond lengths.
the phonon shifts in PrMnO 3 and NdMno3 are attributed to an orbital–spin-phonon coupling, whereas in TbMno3 and DyMno3, they are rather attributed to a change in the Mn−O distance.

the investigation of the structural and vibrational properties of the manganites PrMnO 3, NdM nO 3, T bMnO 4 and D yMnO 5 by Raman scattering as a function of the temperature and applied magnetic field.
the investigation of the magnetic field and temperature dependent properties of the Raman spectra of the multiferroics TbMnO 3 and DyMno 3.
the study of the structural, electronic, magnetic and optical properties of the multiferroics TbMnO 3 and DyMno 3.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the frequency softening in TbMn0.9Cr0.1O3 and Dy1-xCaxMnO3 are due to the oxygen rearrangements, while the softening in PrMn1-xCrxO3 is due to the orbital-spin-phononic coupling.
the Raman shifts observed in the multiferrous TbMnO 3 and DyMno3 are due to the local oxygen rearrangement induced by the magnetic field.
the Raman spectra provide a direct evidence of a spin-orbital coupling in the non-multiferrocies PrMnO and NdMnOs, and a spin-orbitor-phonon coupling in the multiferrocies TbMnO and DyMnOs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the phonon anomalies in the multiferromagnetic TbMnO 3 and DyMno 3 are due to the local oxygen rearrangment under magnetic field, while the anomalous phonon softening in the non-multiferromagnetic PrMnO 2 and NdMnOs 3 are due both to local oxygen rearrangemnt under magnetic field and the orbital-spin-phon coupling.
the phonons in PrMnO 3 and NdMno 3 are more sensitive to the structural changes than those in TbMn O3 and DyMno 3.
